svg.title: Meta Sparse Memory Finetuning and Contextual Scaffolding Architecture
svg.desc: Sparse memory slot routing, targeted memory surgery for continual learning, and the SCMS validation pipeline
svg.text: Meta Sparse Memory Finetuning & Contextual Scaffolding
Targeted Memory Slot Surgery, Top-K Gated Plasticity, and the SCMS Validation Lifecycle
• Sparse memory bank: M ∈ R^(K × d)
• Sparsity factor: k / K < 5% (e.g., only 2 to 4 slots updated per domain).
• Gradient Mask: G_M = ∇_M L ⊙ Mask_TopK (Gradients zeroed for 95%+ of bank).
Guarantees parameter isolation across tasks without maintaining multiple model checkpoints.
• Splits input queries into dual sub-keys (q = [q_1, q_2]) to index K^2 memory slots.
• Expands capacity to 1,000,000+ slots with only O(sqrt(K)) addressing compute.
Provides hardware-efficient scale without increasing forward-pass tensor FLOPS.
Validation Pipeline vs Digital Attic Paradigm
• Digital Attic: Users dump unverified instructions into context; 65% are write-only.
• Validation Pipeline: Operates as an automated test suite for knowledge; only reusable
patterns that survive multi-session verification are retained permanently.
Token Quality > Token Quantity: Saves 53% tokens per developer workflow.
Improvement in retained patterns over baseline
• 53% Token Compression: Eliminates bloated system prompts and repetitive instructions.
• 98% Documentation Lag Reduction: Architecture rules auto-generate from code sessions.
• Model Agnostic: Integrates into Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and Claude Code environments.
Democratizes persistent intelligence without requiring heavy multi-GPU cluster fine-tuning.
